name: cloud-native-serverless-orchestration
description: Use when the user asks about AWS Step Functions, Amazon States Language (ASL) state machines, orchestrating Lambdas, Standard vs Express workflows, Distributed Map, Retry/Catch, or a saga with Step Functions. Produces valid ASL with error handling and direct service integrations. Not for Azure Durable Functions (use cloud-native-azure-functions) or Airflow (use data-airflow-dbt-orchestration).
